name: Model Left Full Body
shortDescription: Full-body Vietnamese model on the left, product matrix on the right.
promptNotes: Place a full-body Vietnamese football model on the left side, visible from head to boots. Arrange front shirt, back shirt, and exactly one shorts view on the right. Keep title/SKU at the top and controls/contact at the bottom.

name: Model Right Full Body
shortDescription: Full-body Vietnamese model on the right, product matrix on the left.
promptNotes: Place a full-body Vietnamese football model on the right side, visible from head to boots. Arrange front shirt, back shirt, and exactly one shorts view on the left. Keep title/SKU at the top and controls/contact at the bottom.

name: Model Left Portrait
shortDescription: Upper-body or three-quarter portrait model on the left, larger product surfaces on the right.
promptNotes: Place a Vietnamese football model as an upper-body or three-quarter portrait on the left, cropped around thigh, waist, or chest depending on spacing. Make the separate front shirt and back shirt larger on the right, with exactly one shorts view below them.

name: Model Right Portrait
shortDescription: Upper-body or three-quarter portrait model on the right, larger product surfaces on the left.
promptNotes: Place a Vietnamese football model as an upper-body or three-quarter portrait on the right, cropped around thigh, waist, or chest depending on spacing. Make the separate front shirt and back shirt larger on the left, with exactly one shorts view below them.

name: Product Focus No Model
shortDescription: No human model; front, back, shorts, collar controls, and copy become the hero.
promptNotes: Do not include a human model. Make the separate front shirt, back shirt, and exactly one shorts view the main hero in a strong catalog grid. Use extra space for readable title, SKU, offer, collar selector, size selector, material line, feature badges, website, and hotline.
